summary.text: Gatecrash takes place in Ravnica's guild-torn streets and the Rubblebelt, where Jace begins to piece together the greater mystery of the Implicit Maze, setting off a race to unlock its secrets.

It follows figures such as Gideon, whom the angel Aurelia invites to command a Boros battalion to cleanse the contested Ninth, and the Gruul warrior Kal, who learns from watching the Izzet and incinerates a Rakdos swarm with a new spell.
The Gruul claim bloodcrime on the Rakdos after a Selesnyan healers' camp is massacred, while the guilds fight over the Ninth.
